source.source_text: Purpose: send bounded text/keys only to an approved focused UI target. Input: element_ref:string, text:string<=10000, submit?:boolean. Output: characters accepted and postcondition state, never echoed from secure fields. Contract: L4 writes_local; scope mac.ui.control; target ui_element; timeout 15000ms; cap 256KiB; no network/filesystem; MUST refuse password, credential, security/privacy and secure text fields; approval trusted_gui; non-idempotent. Phase 4 planned.
